Fallout 76 Beginner Heavy Gunner Guide

Community discussion by a player

In Fallout 76, a beginner Heavy Gunner should prepare equipment and ammunition before pursuing a later build.

Repair available equipment and collect ammunition while exploring nearby areas. Use a starter weapon until enough ammunition and suitable perks become available for heavy weapons. Treat Power Armor as a later progression goal and preserve resources for repairing equipment.

A beginner Heavy Gunner should repair available equipment and collect ammunition before committing to heavy weapons.
